sources.title: Devseis Endpoint Auditor 0.5B (v0.1) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A small language model fine-tuned by Devseis to write endpoint audit findings for ISO 27001, GDPR and the EU AI Act from collected evidence. It runs on the device (WebLLM in the Devseis Endpoint Auditor desktop app and phone check), so audit evidence never leaves the computer or phone.
